(()=>{const t=document.querySelector('textarea');if(!t)throw Error('Composer missing');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set.call(t,"Read audit-brief.txt and tell me the room name and dimensions. Do not draw anything.");t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return true})()

(async()=>{if(document.querySelector('.live-assistant')?.innerText.includes('Working…'))throw Error('Completed call still marked Working');const id=(await import('/src/studio/store.ts')).useStudio.getState().job.id;const saved=await(await import('/src/studio/assistant/chatHistory.ts')).readChatArchive(id);if(!saved?.threads.some(t=>t.entries.some(e=>e.kind==='assistant'&&e.text.includes('Willow'))))throw Error('Provider reply not saved');return {threadCount:saved.threads.length,entries:saved.threads.at(-1).entries.length}})()

(async()=>{const provider=(await import('/src/studio/assistant/provider.ts')).useAssistantProvider;provider.getState().setProvider('minimax');const calls=[];const original=window.fetch;window.fetch=(...args)=>{calls.push(String(args[0]));return original(...args)};let result;try{result=await(await import('/src/studio/assistant/session.ts')).callAssistantTool('web_search',{query:'Find the official Australian Bureau of Meteorology website and return its URL.'},AbortSignal.timeout(90000));}catch(e){result={isError:true,content:[{type:'text',text:e.message}]}}finally{window.fetch=original}if(provider.getState().provider!=='minimax')throw Error('Selected provider changed during search');if(!calls.some(p=>p.includes('/api/assistant-ai')))throw Error('Search not routed to grounding provider');return {requests:calls,selected:provider.getState().provider,result}})()
